semiconductor_relevance: Medium — xMEMS Labs focuses on MEMS technology and piezoelectric components, which are relevant to the semiconductor industry but do not directly involve traditional semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: xMEMS Labs is pioneering the development of piezoMEMS technology, creating solid-state MEMS speakers and μCooling fan-on-a-chip solutions. Their innovations enhance thermal management and audio performance in consumer electronics such as AI glasses, earbuds, and smartphones.
